note: SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURES. Not real measurements. Rate is derived from bytes and duration and is never stored as a primary quantity.
semantics_ref: PHASE_4_CROSS_CUTTING_TECHNICAL_DECISION_CONTRACT.md D4-7. Units: bits per second = bytes * 8 / (transfer_ms / 1000), decimal (1 kbit = 1000 bit).

ramp_up_excluded_intervals.note: Fixture-only illustration of excluding the first interval. Not a product threshold. Real values must come from pilots.

fixtures.description: Stopped at the byte cap: 250,000 bytes in 2000 ms with a 250,000 byte cap. A valid, explicitly labeled result.
Slow network stopped at the time box: 12,500 bytes in 5000 ms. Truthful low value, not a failure.
Zero bytes by the time box: failure with a stage, never a rate of zero.
Interval samples with a TCP-style ramp: 100,000 then three intervals of 300,000 bytes, 200 ms each. Interval bytes must sum to the total.
